text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty INC-3543216789 fired for service=hosted-inference (high retry rate). Primary oncall @sre-oncall did not ack within 2m. Escalating to secondary @maria. Attempting SMS -> voice fallback. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/3543216789

sre-oncall: saw the spike in traces, putting this on my radar. any confirmed customer impact?

maria: I didn’t get the SMS (carrier throttled). I got a voice call attempt but it dropped. I’m switching to wifi calling, joining as soon as I can.

incidentbot: Escalation to manager @kevin queued after secondary timeout. SMS gateway reports quota throttle for +1-555-0102 (maria). Trying voice fallback again.

kevin: mid-flight, poor cell. can’t take a voice bridge right now. set manager fallback to @ops-manager.

ops-manager: I’m awake, joining bridge. drop the PD escalation to me and open a temporary Zoom bridge: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000

alex: quick surface check — hitting elevated 502s on /v1/generate from us-west. correlating with bursts of grpc retries.

sre-oncall: running quick probe: ```
$ kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | egrep "model|runtime"
inference-runtime-0   0/1 CrashLoopBackOff   3 (2m ago)   10.2.4.56
inference-runtime-1   1/1 Running           0 (10m ago)  10.2.4.57
```

alex: curl to the publicLB shows intermittent 502s: ```
$ for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate; sleep 1; done
200
502
502
200
200
```

maria: on bridge now. i’m checking the autoscaler — looks like a flurry of pod restarts triggered by a bad kernel param in the recent config roll. rolling it back to previous revision.

sre-oncall: rollback applied to inference-deploy@v12 -> v11. triggering a soft-restart for pods.

incidentbot: Manager escalation to @kevin FAILED (no ack within 3m). Fallback to @ops-manager confirmed. Notifying execs via pagerduty-notify.

ops-manager: applying throttling patch to client retries, pushing 30s client-side backoff. also increasing pod replicas by +2 temporarily.

maria: patch and replica increase applied. pods coming up. watching logs — error rate trending down.

alex: linking to customer-facing monitoring graph: https://monitoring.redwood.example/d/abc123/hosted-inference?from=-15m&to=now (latency spike ~+400ms, error rate peaked ~3.2% for ~8 minutes)

sre-oncall: Customer impact: small percentage of requests saw 5xx and retries; no data corruption, no PII exposure. CS notified to draft customer message if it stays elevated.

maria: confirming: by my count error rate back to baseline (~0.1%). cleaning up temporary replicas.

ops-manager: thanks team. I’ll escalate to infra for SMS gateway quota evaluation and add PD rule to try alternate contact method sooner when SMS fails.

kevin: pinged; will join post-flight and help with follow-up.

incidentbot: Incident INC-3543216789 acknowledged by @maria, @ops-manager. Creating incident ticket for postmortem and action items (owner: @sre-oncall).

sre-oncall: I’ll own the postmortem. initial notes: SMS gateway throttle triggered manager escalation chain and caused a 3–4m handoff delay. action items: add secondary contact methods, add SMS gateway health monitor, tighten PD escalation windows for critical services.

maria: +1. will add the rollback play to the runbook so oncall can revert quickly.

alex: leaving logs/snippets in the incident doc. good job. :thumbsup: :phone:
